n1.text: Step 2 (Questions) is the homework Questions step reused as is (see the homework canvas, NewHomework-Phone): Choice (A–H, optional text, one or more right), Number (with a tolerance) and Essay (text and/or one photo), each with a model answer and optional photo. Correcting reuses the homework correcting screen.

n2.text: Paper exam (marks only, for now): Details → Marks. No questions and no When step: a maximum mark only. Later: a printed bubble sheet the teacher photographs, so EduLabs reads the choice answers and the essay marks. That builds on this; nothing is thrown away.

n3.text: When (online): by default the exam happens in each Group's next session on or after a date the teacher picks. EduLabs reads the times from the Groups' sessions; the teacher never types them. Change = pick another session of that Group. Or: Same time for everyone (one window, e.g. at home).
